visual_filter_vs_ranking.filter: technical usability (is-edit already applied it; the pool is uniformly usable)
visual_filter_vs_ranking.conclusion: among already-usable shots, the differentiators are content/action/sequence, not raw technical quality -- confirms quality behaves as a FILTER, not a strong RANKER

shot_selection_grammar.visual_filter: exclude unusable (blurred/blown/obstructed); is-edit already encodes this
shot_selection_grammar.source_moment: pick the action peak / settled readable moment, not the setup or aftermath
shot_selection_grammar.event_importance: cake, first dance, bouquet, entrance, reception survive; generic guest filler is dropped
shot_selection_grammar.sequence_fit: keep shots that build a mini-sequence; drop individually-fine but redundant alternatives
shot_selection_grammar.source_reuse: reuse one source across forward-progressing moments to show one event's phases
shot_selection_grammar.music_fit: faster cuts on higher-energy reception (song 2), calmer/longer on day (song 1)
shot_selection_grammar.causality: order action phases correctly (setup -> action -> reaction)

current_planner_coverage.note: planner reuses source only until consumed, not deliberately for event phases
shot_windows pick technically-good windows, not action peaks
moment bonus exists but truncation blocks reception moments

current_planner_coverage.grammar: continue into reception while strong candidates remain
current_planner_coverage.note: cut-run + 50%-deliverable early-exit stops in the day story

examples: the first-dance / cake region V7 built
false_early_stop.conclusion: At the ~96s planner stop there is a large pool of genuinely good, coherent reception/party/first-dance/cake candidates in the editor's own selects -- not merely technically-valid shots. FALSE-EARLY-STOP is now very strongly supported.

updated_p6_16_requirements: continue while coherent HIGH-VALUE story candidates remain (reception/first-dance/cake/bouquet), not merely any usable clip
relax the cut-run / 50%-deliverable early-exit that stops in the day story
allow deliberate forward same-source reuse to build event phase-sequences (sparkler, first dance, bouquet)
prefer action-phase moments over static setups within a source
do NOT require using every good shot -- keep a tightened, non-redundant subset
reframe duration around a coherent-story endpoint (~123s like V7), not a fixed 180s
